key_concepts: Mouse In CHOP outputs mouse X and Y screen values.
It outputs left, right, and middle button states as 0 for up and 1 for down.
Active controls whether mouse movement is captured and whether the CHOP cooks every frame.
Output Coordinates can be normalized, aspect-adjusted normalized, or absolute pixels.
Wheel and current monitor can be output as additional channels.
Panels limits events to a specified focused panel.
common_gotchas: When Active is Off, the operator does not cook and current mouse X/Y values are not output.
While Playing captures mouse events only while the timeline is playing forward.
Normalized coordinates are centered on the primary monitor; absolute coordinates are pixels with 0,0 at the primary monitor bottom-left.
Do not hardcode channel names because position and button channel names are parameter-defined.
Panels restricts events to the focused specified panel, which is important in multi-panel UIs.
